title: The federal and state law reservation on a certified technician receiving prescription information
rule_summary: The authority 247 CMR 8.04(4)(c) gives a certified pharmacy technician, after identifying him or herself as such, to request refill authorizations from the prescriber or prescriber's agent and, with the approval of the pharmacist on duty, to receive new or omitted prescription information from the prescriber or agent, is granted 'except where otherwise prohibited by federal or state laws and regulations'. The reservation sits in the same sentence as the grant, so the grant does not reach an act that another federal or state law or regulation prohibits.
exam_relevance: Prevents the certified technician's telephone communication authority from being read as exhaustive on its own conditions, because 247 CMR 8.04(4)(c) expressly yields to any other federal or state law or regulation prohibiting the act.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: The grant does not apply where otherwise prohibited by federal or state laws and regulations.
common_confusions: Certification and the on-duty pharmacist's approval are conditions inside the grant; the reservation is a separate limit that can close the grant even when both conditions are met.
The reservation reaches state law as well as federal law, so a Massachusetts statute governing the same act is within it.
verification_notes: Read in the current Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 on mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
